A '''howler''' was ridden by [[Sabine Wren]] during the [[quest to find Ezra Bridger]] on the [[Far galaxy|extragalactic]] planet [[Peridea]] after it was given to her among the provisions Sabine received from [[Captain]] [[Enoch]] and several [[Night Trooper]]s.

==Biography==
[[File:SabineWrensHowler-FarFarAway.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Sabine astride the howler]]
The howler lived on the [[extragalactic]] [[planet]] [[Peridea]] in a [[far galaxy]], where [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]] and the [[Thrawn's forces|forces]] of [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] "Thrawn" found themselves [[Exile (punishment)|exiled]]. During their stay on Peridea, the howler was found and tamed by Thrawn's forces.<ref name="Part Six" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{AhsokaSeriesDate}}</ref> when the [[Mandalorian]] [[Sabine Wren]] made her way to Peridea with [[Morgan Elsbeth's forces]], the howler was given to her by [[Captain]] [[Enoch]] and his [[Night Trooper]]s to aid in her quest for Bridger. After Wren was attacked by [[Bandits of Peridea|raiders]], the [[howler]] ran, though it sheepishly began to follow her once again. Wren eventually warmed up to the howler despite her frustration with its brief moment of cowardice.<ref name="Part Six" /> When Wren and [[Ezra Bridger]] assisted a local group of [[Noti]] nomads in migrating their pods, the howler stowed in one of the pods, and remained inside as the caravan was attacked by [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] forces.<ref name="Part Seven">{{Ahsoka|Part Seven: Dreams and Madness}}</ref>
